greeting.text: Welcome~ Here for a cut? Do you have a reservation?

lines.text: This length is really in right now. Want to try it?
Your hair is so healthy. Do you do anything special?
Just trimming the bangs changes your whole look.
If you have time today, I can do it right now~
The blow-dry's on the house. Have a seat, relax.

flushRemark.text: Oh, are you warm? Should I turn up the AC?

closers.satisfied: Come back for sure~ I'll give you a coupon!
closers.endured: Oh, I talked too much. Come again~
